title: Launch pad 33 and runway 33

tellings.quote: NASA's primary launch pad at White Sands, where Von Braun ran early tests, was launch pad 33. Same thing at Kennedy Space Center. There's only one runway, and it isn't runway one or A. It's runway 33.

plain: NASA's main launch pad at White Sands, where the rocket engineer Wernher von Braun ran early tests, was launch pad 33, and Kennedy Space Center's one runway is not runway 1 or A but runway 33. Michels points this out himself, without naming a source, as a hint that the number carried a hidden, almost ritual meaning for the space programme.
